answer: A farm of 81 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are logged in reef, queued in anchor, and juniper publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 54 identities per epoch. A farm of 3555 identities would post 1865 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
